summary: Admin panel application for managing comment lists and live event/app tracking with username management
architectural_notes: Admin panel requires authentication via caffeineAdminToken in URL hash
Two main sections: Comment Lists and Apps/Events (Live Lists)
Comment lists support bulk operations (one per line input, file upload)
known_issues: Bug: Comment list creation button does not create lists (pending fix in Build 1)
Bug: Live list (Apps/Events) creation button does not create lists (pending fix in Build 2)

existing_features.title: Wire the 'Create New Comment List' section's 'Create' button to call the backend create function with the entered list ID from the input field
Display loading state on the 'Create' button while the backend request is in progress, and disable the button during submission to prevent duplicate requests
Validate that the list ID input field is not empty before allowing submission, displaying an error message if the user attempts to create a list without entering an ID

new_feature_requests.summary: Create Admin Panel with comment list creation functionality
Create Admin Panel with live list (Apps/Events) creation functionality
Add comment management features (lock, delete, add comments, upload file)
Add Apps/Events management features with username tracking
Implement backend Motoko function to create a new comment list with a provided list ID, ensuring the list is persisted in the backend state and returns success confirmation
